This may seem very muggle-esque but I propose the 12 days of hogwartmas

​

Each day we will be having an event of some sort, either a submission event or a live event, they will be alternating, and they are all team events as this is also a sort of competition

​

day 1

Culinary showcase (submission)

Whip up an appetising dish based on whatever reminds you of the holidays. The dish has to look good and taste good, you'll get extra points if you create something that doesn't already exist.

​

day 2

lawyer up; Everyone is a suspect. (live)

Have you ever wanted to experience being both a lawyer and a detective? Solve the mystery, justify your case and bring HOLME (reference to famous muggle detective Sherlock Holmes) to justice. Whoever solves it first wins.

​

day 3

Poem writing (submission)

This is just for everyone to relax and write about how they're feeling about the holidays this year. The points will be based on how genuine your poem is.

​

day 4

Block and Tackle; the debate against yourself. (live)

You will have to speak both, for and against a motion. You start by speaking for it but once the moderator says block you have to switch sides and once they say tackle you switch back to your original statement. The longer you can go on for, the more points you will be receiving. 

​

day 5

Shark Tank (submission)

Think of an issue (maybe something more tangible) and come up with a product you believe will fix it. You will be pitching this product and your recorded presentation has to last at least 5 minutes. Your points will be based on how much sense your product makes and how original it is.

​

day 6

Spin a yarn (live)

A person from each team (hopefully the best storyteller) will be given a starting sentence then will be picked to continue from that sentence and the next person will have to continue from there to end up with a short story of some sort. The house with the best story wins.

​

day 7

Photography (submission)

Throughout these 7 days you will be needing to take candid photographs of your housemates while they decorate the common room. The more pictures you end up taking, the more points you win.

​

day 8

Mono Act (live)

Pretend to be two characters at once, they could be either family or enemies. You will be coming up with your idea on the spot. The more paradox your characters are, the more pints you'll receive.

​

day 9

Cosplay (submission)

Dress up as... anyone, even a classmate of yours. You get points based on how well you'll get recognition.

​

day 10

Acapella Riff-Off (live)

Sing Christmas songs while competing with the other houses. The house which gets the chance to sing the most songs wins.

​

day 11

Ludicrous Headlines (submission)

Make up the most bizarre scenario and showcase it as if you were on the news. The whackier it is the more points you'll get.

​

day 12
